theorems.name: Erdos647TailKillTauProofChunks.FinitePrefixComposition.tailKillFinitePrefixMechanismVerified_of_bound
theorems.statement_summary: If 10 <= K r s u for u < 101, then FinitePrefixMechanismVerifiedBy K (fun _ _ => 101).

theorems.name: Erdos647TailKillTauProofChunks.FinitePrefixComposition.patchedK

theorems.name: Erdos647TailKillTauProofChunks.FinitePrefixComposition.patchedK_prefix_bound
